text: Computer Age Management Services Ltd. provides a range of financial‑services solutions, primarily through its mutual‑fund (MF) platform and a broad non‑MF suite that includes payments, alternatives, KRA (KYC‑Ready‑Account) services, and GIFT City‑based retail and SIF offerings. The MF arm generates about 10 % revenue growth year‑on‑year, while the non‑MF segment drives stronger growth, expanding over 28 % in the quarter. Together, these two pillars account for the company’s total revenue, with the non‑MF business representing the larger share of the top line.
